reference: K. Krupa, A. Tonello, A. Barthelemy, T. Mansuryan, V. Couderc, G. Millot, P. Grelu, D. Modotto, S. A. Babin, S. Wabnitz, Multimode nonlinear fiber optics, a spatiotemporal avenue, APL Photonics 4, 110901 (2019)
original_paper: K. Krupa, A. Tonello, A. Barthelemy, V. Couderc, B. M. Shalaby, A. Bendahmane, G. Millot, S. Wabnitz, Observation of geometric parametric instability induced by the periodic spatial self-imaging of multimode waves, Phys. Rev. Lett. 116, 183901 (2016), arXiv:1602.04991
description: Reproduction of the geometric parametric instability (GPI) sideband ladder: a strong quasi-CW beam in a GRIN MMF self-images with period xi and the resulting longitudinal index grating quasi-phase-matches a degenerate FWM cascade to discrete frequency shifts f_h ~ sqrt(h) f_m, reaching ~124.5 THz at first order (1064 nm pump). Review Fig. 14 left panel = PRL Fig. 3; total spectrum reproduced here with the modal engine.

page_refs.core_radius / n_co / n_cl / delta / beta: PRL p.3 (analytic section); review p.18 quote kappa'' = 16.55e-27 s2/m
page_refs.self_imaging_period: PRL p.3 (xi = 0.615 mm); review Fig. 21 (0.6 mm measured, 50/125 um fiber, 1030 nm pump)

pump.quasi_cw: PRL numerics use a 9 ps pulse (much longer than the soliton/GPI time scales) to emulate the sub-ns experiment

page_refs.pump/beam/length (numerics): PRL p.3 (In the numerics we used an input beam diameter of 40 um ... pulse duration of 9 ps, input intensity I = 10 GW/cm2 ... fiber's length of 0.4 m)
page_refs.pump/beam/length (experiment): PRL p.3 (In the experiment, we used a 6m-long standard GRIN MMF ... Pp-p = 50 kW ... FWHM diameter of 35 um)

gpi_ladder.qpm_condition: 2 k_P - k_S - k_A = -2 pi h / xi

page_refs.qpm + formula: PRL p.3 (2 k_P - k_S - k_A = -2 pi h/xi; (2 pi f_h)^2 = 2 pi h/(xi kappa'') - 2 n2 I_hat omega0/(c kappa''))
page_refs.nonlinear shift: PRL p.4 (pulse intensity x4 => ~2 THz shift at h=1)

numerics_original.scheme: 3+1D Gross-Pitaevskii split-step (direct field); periodic in t, zeroed field at window boundaries

numerics_ours.note: modal (equivalent) implementation: symmetric LP0p ladder of the truncated-parabolic GRIN fiber with paraxial beta_p(omega), per-mode group delays, per-mode phase offsets delta beta0^(p) = -2 pi p / xi (the self-imaging grating, added to the engine for this reproduction), intermodal FWM with Manley-Rowe pump depletion; equivalent to the PRL's direct GP solver per review Sec. III Eq. (4) Gaussian-ansatz justification
numerics_ours.noise_stands_in_for: GP roundoff/chaos self-seeding; ladder positions insensitive to it

cases.experiment_faithful_fig14: L = 6 m, P_p-p = 50 kW, 35 um FWHM Gaussian
cases.numerics_power_check: L = 0.4 m, I = 10 GW/cm2 (P_p-p = 12.57 kW over 40 um 1/e2), x4 run
